title: DataBall appends must merge schemas by name with numeric widening
lead: The physical column is widened in place with `ALTER COLUMN … SET DATA TYPE`, for wide and layout sessions alike. Any other type conflict throws, naming the column, both types and both sources. db-11 reuses this rule for many-file opens.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** opening many files (db-11); DATE/TIMESTAMP widening; changes to replace imports.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Split out of db-11 on 2026-10-10. Owner decisions: schema merge by default with numeric widening (suite alignment doc), and widening in layout sessions alters the owning physical column (db-11 spec interview, 2026-10-10).

From reviews:
- Layout physical types were fixed at first import, and appends were cast to them.
- db-08 added an in-place `ALTER … SET DATA TYPE` path for all-null columns (`InferredNullColumnType`). Reuse it.

**Model note (owner, 2026-10-10):** Claude-only relay. Implementer: **Haiku 5.5, high**, a trial on a small, well-scoped slice. The reviewer and architect models are set at relay start.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/DataBall/DuckDbStore.cs` (`AppendFromTable`, `MergeOrAppendFromTable`) and `DuckDbStore.Layout.cs` (`AppendStagingIntoLayout`): the merge and widening rules above, inside the append transaction. Config-typed columns keep casting to their configured type.
- `README.md` "Tables" ("physical column types are fixed at the first import") and `docs/how-it-works.md`.
- Tests: new `tests/DataBall.Tests/SchemaMergeTests.cs`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `Append_UnionByName_NullForMissing` (wide and layout).
2. `Append_Widens` (theory, wide and layout): INTEGER then BIGINT then DOUBLE. Assert the owning physical column's type in `information_schema.columns`.
3. `Append_VarcharVsDouble_Throws`: the message names the column, both types and both sources; the session is unchanged.
4. `Append_ConfigTypedColumn_StillCasts`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Spec review.
2. `slicer start` with `--render --strict`. Write tests 1–4, watch them fail.
3. Implement; docs; mutation checks; full Release suite; format.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build DataBall.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test DataBall.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet format DataBall.sln --verify-no-changes`
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Must not change
sections.body:
- Replace imports and their column types are unchanged.
- Config-typed columns still cast.
- A failed append leaves the session unchanged (one transaction).
